correctness.rationale: Exactly five overlap offsets give the full entrywise covariance for all n>=5. Constant, symmetric-zero-row, skew-zero-row and two standard contrast sectors exhaust the dimension q(q-1); each has the eigenvalue claimed. Explicit strict radical inequalities prove positivity and ordering. The m-dependent CLT yields the stated fixed-q multivariate normal and chi-square limits, with exact finite verification by checker.py.

value.rationale: The color-resolved count vector gives a natural null calibration for all q(q-1) ordered nonconstant palindrome motifs. Five explicit symmetry-sector variances separate color contrast from directed circulations, giving complete classification, invertibility at every finite n, and an asymptotic chi-square omnibus diagnostic without numerical inversion of estimated covariance; the high-q condition-number limit quantifies stability. This is more than recomputing a single pattern count.
